asks: What the role asks for: the requirements a reader of this CV screens on, in their words.
The proof the CV must carry: which of the verified achievements in the brief answer each requirement. Use only achievements the brief lists.
The one action: what the reader should do after reading, and what on the first page earns it.
The voice, as the brief decides it, restated as two or three rules both writers keep.

seats.angle_brief: Every entry leads with the result: what changed because of the work, with its measure, and then how it was done.
Every entry leads with the remit: the size of what was owned (people, systems, budget, reach), and then what was delivered within it.
